t: Getting away from people who mean you harm
a: فَخَرَجَ مِنْهَا خَآئِفًا يَتَرَقَّبُ ۖ قَالَ رَبِّ نَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
m: So he left it, fearful and anticipating [apprehension]. He said, "My Lord, save me from the wrongdoing people."
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
